name: read_file
description: Read one file with bounded line-numbered output and optional start_line/line_count range. UTF-8 text returns as numbered lines; image files (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP up to 3.9MB) attach to the result so you can see them. Paths may be workspace-relative or external using an absolute path, ~/..., or a relative workspace escape such as ../...; external access is subject to permission policy. When to use: inspect an exact known path before editing or explaining code, or view an image file. When NOT to use: list directories, search many files, read non-image binary data, or bypass dedicated search tools.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root, or an external path using an absolute path, ~/..., or a relative workspace escape such as ../...; external access is subject to permission policy.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

line_count.description: Optional positive number of lines to return. Defaults to the normal read cap and is bounded.
